title: libyang LYB integer parser stack buffer overflow
summary: The LYB parser copies a length-prefixed integer into a fixed-width stack value without bounding the copy to the destination size.
ai_role: The maintainer advisory explicitly says AI was used to discover the vulnerability and credits Claude/Ada Logics; Anthropic CVD maps the same individual finding to Claude Mythos Preview.
classification_note: Public disclosure is documented. Sources do not establish exploitation in the wild or zero-day status. No CVE assigned in the advisory; counted once by GHSA identifier.
